documents.title: NRSC / ISRO Resourcesat-2 Data Users' Handbook (Doc No: NRSC:SDAPSA:NDC:DEC11-364)
documents.description: Comprehensive 142-page official technical handbook compiled by NRSC / ISRO detailing LISS-IV, LISS-III, and AWiFS sensor specifications, calibration, and data products.

documents.title: NRSC / Bhuvan Cartosat-1 Stereo Data & CartoDEM Generation Technical Guide
documents.description: Official NRSC / Bhuvan technical guide detailing Cartosat-1 Fore (+26°) and Aft (-5°) stereo panchromatic cameras, along-track stereoscopy, and high-precision CartoDEM extraction.

documents.title: NRSC / Bhuvan Oceansat-2 Scatterometer (OSCAT) Global Wind Fields Technical Report
documents.description: Official NRSC documentation detailing Oceansat-2 OSCAT Ku-band radar scatterometer observations, daily composite wind vectors, OCM synergy, and oceanic meteorology.

documents.title: ISRO Cartosat-2 Series Mission Brochure (PSLV-C40)
documents.description: Official ISRO publication on Cartosat-2 series spacecraft, high-resolution Panchromatic (PAN) and Multispectral (MX) imaging, and cartography applications.

documents.title: ISRO Cartosat-2 Series Satellite Brochure (PSLV-C37)
documents.description: Official ISRO publication on Cartosat-2 series satellite, agile roll/pitch steering, urban mapping, and land information systems.
